proof_body:
by
  intro ι s v r hv
  classical
  refine ⟨Lagrange.interpolate s v r, ⟨Lagrange.degree_interpolate_lt r hv, fun i hi => Lagrange.eval_interpolate_at_node r hv hi⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro Q ⟨hd, he⟩
  exact Lagrange.eq_interpolate_of_eval_eq r hv hd he
target_source: ∀ (ι : Type*) (s : Finset ι) (v r : ι → ℝ), Set.InjOn v s → ∃! P : Polynomial ℝ, P.degree < s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, P.eval (v i) = r i
